scopeNotes: Fresh final run after all known text overflow corrections; 20 manifest pages at six HTTP widths plus all 20 file pages at 375px.
Local resource and fragment checks total 798: 552 anchor references and 246 asset/style/script references. External network destinations were not followed.

Text overflow checks inspect visible text ranges against viewport plus semantic text element scrollWidth and product-title line boxes; offscreen horizontal filter scroll areas, decorative plus rotation, hidden dialogs and decorative images are excluded.
Fonts are checked after document.fonts.ready. Sans and Hand load on every tested page; Poster is loaded on index, where used, and legitimately unused on other pages.
Images are forced eager and awaited through decode before validation to avoid lazy-loading false positives.
One file-mode interaction configuration exercises three serving tabs, catalogue categories/meat/search, and the resulting product route. Mailto/tel links and form submit were not invoked.

Production HTML loads style.css, depth.css and design-system.css plus script.js and depth.js. All referenced runtime files and both manifests (56 files total) were hashed before, after and at finalization.
Loading concept demos, unrelated unused assets and earlier QA logs are outside this manifest runtime scope.
Visual QA is handled separately by the parent agent; this report records functional, font loading, title fit, resource and responsive layout checks.
